caption: The drawing depicts a vessel with two horse head-shaped handles, one on each end of the elongated, oval-bodied container. The body of the vessel is primarily brown with reddish tones, and it features decorative wavy patterns in blue, green, and yellow running horizontally across the surface. There are additional circular and curved motifs in red and yellow near the handles. The horse heads have carved details to indicate ears, eyes, and manes, and are colored in deep brown with reddish highlights. The interior of the vessel appears dark, almost black. The background is a plain, off-white color, and the artist's signature, "FRANK MCENTEE," appears in small text on the right side of the drawing.
title: Drinking Vessel (Loving Cup)
